chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Humran ibn A'yan from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who had to perform Tawaf al-Nisa' alone, he performed five rounds of the Kaaba, then his stomach was seized by discomfort, and he feared losing control, so he went to his house, relieved himself, and then had intercourse with his maidservant. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should perform ghusl, then return and perform the remaining rounds of his tawaf with the Kaaba, and seek forgiveness from his Lord, and not repeat this.'

key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa', ritual circumambulation for sexual release
key_terms.يَبْدُرَهُ: He loses control (of urine or semen)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who performs Tawaf al-Nisa' and then has intercourse with his maidservant?
ai.summary: This ruling from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih* addresses the specific scenario of a man performing Tawaf al-Nisa' alone who, fearing premature ejaculation, relieves himself and then has intercourse with his maidservant. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes that he must perform ghusl, complete the remaining rounds of his tawaf, seek forgiveness, and avoid repeating the action, highlighting the flexibility in completing ritual obligations even after sexual release.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2788 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Humran ibn A‘yan, from Imam Abu Ja‘far (as), regarding a man who was performing Tawaf al-Nisa and completed five rounds of the Kaaba. He then felt discomfort in his stomach and feared he might lose control, so he went to his residence, relieved himself, and then had intercourse with his maidservant.
Imam (as) said: "He should perform ghusl, then return to the Kaaba to complete the remaining rounds of his tawaf. He should seek forgiveness from his Lord (azj) and not repeat this action."
